derivation: The rshell backdoor the trojanized MiMi Linux build carried, fetched from Software Heritage by content hash and re-measured against the digest Trend Micro published.
A statically linked, stripped ELF 64-bit x86-64 executable.
Hopper, MalwareBazaar, Triage and Malshare were all asked for this digest and none had it; Software Heritage indexes source archives and picked it up where the malware feeds did not.
